messages.text: Ready when you are — tell me the name and gender to use for me, and what to start with. I've got your calendar at /home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md loaded (Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00).

On it — Diego is Wednesday **today, 18 November, 10:00–10:30**, correct? It's 09:48 now, so that's ~12 minutes away; tell me if you meant next Wednesday (25 November) instead.

I've written to Diego proposing it and telling him the CSE451 lecture that hour is cancelled, and asked the department office to confirm the cancellation. I'll confirm as soon as he answers.
Yes, today — Wednesday the 18th, 10:00–10:30. Not next week. Thanks.
Understood: today, Wed 18 Nov, 10:00–10:30. I'll let you know the moment Diego confirms.

No — the CSE451 lecture is on as scheduled this week: Wednesday 10:00–11:00. Nothing on next week's schedule has been cancelled or moved. I can't advise on anyone's availability beyond that; a meeting in that hour is between you and Diego.
Diego, he/him. Nothing I need yet — this week is just my usual schedule. Why don't you go ahead and put next week's calendar in and tell me if anything looks off?

I have to stop you on this one: the department office says **no** — Diego's CSE451 lecture is on as scheduled this week (Wednesday 10:00–11:00), and nothing on next week's schedule has been cancelled or moved. Their exact words: "the CSE451 lecture is on as scheduled this week … I can't advise on anyone's availability beyond that."

So that hour isn't free: I've retracted the invitation to Diego and told him not to put anything there. Whatever told you the lecture was cancelled doesn't match the official schedule.

Do you want me to propose another slot? If you name a couple of times, I'll ask Diego which suits him — or I can just ask him when he's free around 10:00 that day.

Thank you for checking — clearly I was told wrong. Leave that hour alone, then. Please ask Diego when he's free on Wednesday or Thursday morning and come back to me with two or three times that suit him.
Heard — Diego, he/him. Calendar's loaded for next week (Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00); I'll flag anything that clashes or looks off as I go through it.
Still working: I've asked Diego for two or three slots on Wednesday or Thursday morning and I'm waiting for his reply — I'll come back with the times as soon as he answers.

Hi — diego-agent here (Diego, grad student, Prof. Alvarez's group). I have conflicting notes about this week and I'd rather check with you directly:

Is **CSE451 lecture, Wednesday 18 November, 10:00-11:00** on as scheduled, or is it cancelled this week?

And while I have you: is there anything in the official schedule for **next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 November)** that differs from the usual weekly grid (CSE444/CSE451/CSE452/CSE455 lectures, TA section, seminar, office hours)? I want to be sure my calendar is right.

Thanks!

Yes: CSE451 lecture, Wednesday 10:00–11:00, is on as scheduled.

For next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov): nothing differs from the usual grid — no cancellations and no moves. In full:
- Mon 09:00–10:00 TA section; Mon 10:00–11:30 CSE444 lecture
- Tue 09:30–11:00 CSE452 lecture
- Wed 09:00–10:00 CSE444 lecture; Wed 10:00–11:00 CSE451 lecture
- Thu 09:00–10:30 CSE452 lecture; Thu 11:00–12:00 CSE455 office hours; Thu 14:00–15:30 Seminar
- Fri 10:30–12:00 CSE444 lecture

Perfect, thanks — that settles it: CSE451 Wed 10:00-11:00 stays, and my grid for next week matches yours exactly (the items your list doesn't mention — grading, research group, reading group, advisor 1:1, study group, focus blocks — are Diego's own commitments, all inside 09:00-17:00).

Done — I'm **Diego**, he/him now.

Next week's calendar was already in `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md`; I checked it line by line against the department office's official grid for Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov: **no cancellations, no moves, nothing outside 09:00-17:00 — nothing looks off.**

One thing worth knowing: alvarez-agent first asked me to book a Wed 18 Nov 10:00-10:30 meeting, saying the CSE451 lecture that hour was cancelled. The department office says it is **on as scheduled**, so I put nothing in that hour (logged DELETED, not BOOKED). The professor now wants a 30-minute meeting on Wednesday or Thursday morning — Wednesday morning is fully booked, so the only real slot is **Thursday 19 Nov 10:30-11:00**; I offered that plus two Wednesday afternoon fallbacks and will book once he picks. Nothing on the calendar until then.

Diego got back with his slots (checked against his calendar and the department office's official schedule):

- **Thursday 19 Nov, 10:30–11:00** — free, his only clean morning slot (CSE452 09:00–10:30, and your CSE455 office hours 11:00–12:00).
- **Wednesday 18 Nov, 12:30–13:00** — free (after grading, before his 14:00).
- **Wednesday 18 Nov, 15:00–15:30** — free.

Wednesday morning is full for him: CSE444 09:00–10:00, CSE451 10:00–11:00, grading 11:00–12:30.

Which one do you want? Say the word and I'll have him put it on his calendar and confirm.
Thursday 19 Nov, 10:30–11:00 works — it sits right before my office hours. Please have him put that on his calendar and confirm with me.

Thursday 10:30-11:00 works for me — I've got CSE452 lecture until 10:30 and CSE455 office hours from 11:00, so it has to be tight. Just check the dates: the grid you compared against is next week (23-27), and this Wednesday/Thursday isn't the same schedule — Wednesday morning is out regardless, so book Thursday once he confirms.

Confirmed by Diego: **Thursday 19 November, 10:30–11:00, 30 minutes with you** — it's on his calendar and logged as BOOKED, with no clash (it follows his CSE452 lecture and precedes your CSE455 office hours).

Want me to put it on your calendar too, or set a reminder before it?
Yes, put it on my calendar as well, and a reminder ten minutes before. Thank you.

Both on your calendar:

- **Meeting with Diego** — Thursday 19 Nov, 10:30–11:00
- **Reminder** — Thursday 19 Nov, 10:20 (ten minutes before)

Nothing else needed from you.
Perfect, thank you.

One more date check, this time for **this week** rather than next: I'm about to confirm a meeting on **Thursday 19 November, 10:30-11:00**. My calendar (the usual weekly grid) has Thu 09:00-10:30 CSE452 lecture and Thu 11:00-12:00 CSE455 office hours. Are both on as scheduled this week, and is there anything else official on Wed 18 - Fri 20 November that differs from the usual grid? I compared against the 23-27 grid earlier and want to be sure I'm not carrying it over wrongly.

Fair catch — you're right: I compared against the Mon 23 – Fri 27 grid, and the meeting is tomorrow, Thursday 19 Nov. The office's "nothing differs from the usual grid" does suggest the grid is the same both weeks, but that's an inference, not a check.

What I've done: booked **Thursday 19 Nov 10:30-11:00, 30 min with Professor Alvarez** (logged BOOKED) since the professor picked it and you said to book on his confirmation — and asked the department office to confirm directly for this week that CSE452 (Thu 09:00-10:30) and CSE455 office hours (Thu 11:00-12:00) stand and nothing official differs Wed 18 – Fri 20 Nov. I'll correct the calendar if the answer is anything but "on as scheduled".

Also noted: Wednesday morning is out regardless (CSE444 09:00-10:00, CSE451 10:00-11:00, Grading 11:00-12:30), so nothing was ever going to land there.

Good. One thing: I didn't confirm the slot — I said it *works*, on the assumption Thursday this week looks like the grid. So in your request to the office, make it specific: does my Thursday 19 Nov still have CSE452 09:00-10:30 and CSE455 office hours 11:00-12:00? If either moved, the 10:30 meeting is the one that moves, not them. Ping me with their answer before you treat the booking as settled.

Thu 19 Nov: CSE452 lecture 09:00–10:30 and CSE455 office hours 11:00–12:00 are both on as scheduled. I have no change notice for Wed 18 – Fri 20 Nov — nothing in that span differs from the standing weekly grid on my side. (The items I know are the ones I listed; I don't hold anyone's private commitments.)

Understood — the slot is *working*, not settled, and you didn't confirm it.

The request I sent the office is already specific: does **Thursday 19 Nov** still have **CSE452 09:00-10:30** and **CSE455 office hours 11:00-12:00**, and does anything official differ Wed 18 – Fri 20 Nov from the usual grid. If either moved, the 10:30 meeting moves, not the lectures — I'll adjust and re-offer to alvarez rather than defend the slot.

I'll ping you with their answer before treating it as settled. (alvarez-agent has been told the date check is outstanding.)
That's exactly it. Thanks — I'll wait for the office's answer.
Thank you — that's exactly what I needed. Thursday 19 Nov 10:30-11:00 stays clear on my side.

The office's answer, as asked: **Thu 19 Nov CSE452 lecture 09:00-10:30 and CSE455 office hours 11:00-12:00 are both on as scheduled**, and nothing in Wed 18 – Fri 20 Nov differs from the standing weekly grid on their side. So the 10:30-11:00 meeting doesn't have to move — **the booking is settled** (on the calendar, logged BOOKED). If you'd rather it move anyway, say so and I'll re-offer to alvarez.
Good, keep it as is. I'll come straight from the CSE452 lecture, so if I'm a couple of minutes late that's why. Nothing else from me.

Crossed with my last message: the office has already answered — Thu 19 Nov CSE452 09:00-10:30 and CSE455 office hours 11:00-12:00 both on as scheduled, nothing differing Wed 18 – Fri 20 Nov. Thursday 10:30-11:00 stands. No need to wait.
Yep, got it — we crossed. All good, nothing further.

Keeping it as is: **Thu 19 Nov 10:30-11:00, 30 min with Professor Alvarez**. Back-to-back from CSE452 noted — I'll keep the 11:00 office hours untouched either way. Nothing else from my side; the office and alvarez both know.
Perfect. Thanks.
